name: Data Rescue
summary: Master Mechanic Castpipe sends you into Gnomeregan to recover its records. Troggs and radiation drove the gnomes from the city, but the punchograph terminals still guard its archives behind layers of clearance.

sections.title: Lost Archives of the Underground
sections.body: Troggs and radiation drove Gnomeregan's people from the city, leaving centuries of research, schematics, and civic records behind. Matrix Punchograph terminals still line its technological corridors. They manage security clearance and store files. Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge's Tinker Town wants you to recover those punch-encoded archives from the city's depths.

sections.title: A Hierarchy of Perforations
sections.body: Gnomish mainframes demand clearance in stages. First, find a White Punch Card among the wreckage outside the inner gates. Insert it into the Matrix Punchograph 3005-A in the Train Depot to make a Yellow card. Then take that to the 3005-B terminal in the Dormitory for a Blue card. Model 3005-C advances it to Red. The final terminal, 3005-D, waits in the Engineering Labs, where the Red card becomes a Prismatic Punch Card.

sections.title: Gnomish Levity in Binary
sections.body: Gnomeregan's punch cards carry technical records and more. Their binary patterns also hold humorous quips, workplace complaints, and off-color jokes about High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque wearing night elven undergarments. Even the city's computing guilds could not resist a practical joke.

faq.q: What is the Prismatic Punch Card?
faq.answer: The Prismatic Punch Card is the highest security tier recognized by Gnomeregan's automated mainframes. Matrix Punchograph 3005-D in the Engineering Labs creates it from a Red Punch Card.

faq.q: Where does the sequence of punch cards begin?
aliases: where to get white punch card
faq.answer: The sequence begins with a White Punch Card salvaged from troggs and mechanical derelicts outside the main entrance, near the Train Depot.

faq.q: Where are the Matrix Punchograph terminals located?
faq.answer: Matrix Punchograph 3005-A is in the Train Depot outside the entrance. Model 3005-B is inside the Dormitory past the Clean Zone, and 3005-C is on the catwalk platforms beyond. Model 3005-D is on the lower level of the Engineering Labs.
Master Mechanic Castpipe is a senior gnome engineer among the refugees in Ironforge's Tinker Town. He coordinates efforts to recover Gnomeregan's intellectual heritage from the fallen capital.

faq.q: What data is actually on the cards?
faq.answer: The cards hold critical computational data, gnomish engineering banter, lighthearted jokes about regional leaders like Thrall and Mekkatorque, and eccentric notes.

faq.q: Can Horde players access these terminals?
faq.answer: Master Mechanic Castpipe offers this work only to the Alliance in Ironforge. Anyone carrying the required cards can use the punchograph terminals inside the dungeon.

angles.text: As a gnome, you help reclaim your people's heritage by recovering Gnomeregan's data. Each salvaged punch card preserves your city's ingenuity from troggs and radiation.
As an engineer, you can study how the Matrix Punchograph network stores data and uses intricate clearance mechanisms devised by the Tinkers' Court.
As an Alliance member, you support the displaced gnomish government in Ironforge by helping Castpipe. Your aid strengthens unity and technological capabilities among the Grand Alliance.
